name: auth-core
description: Production-ready full-stack authentication system with React 19, NestJS, and MongoDB

scripts.db:start: docker start mongo-auth 2>/dev/null || docker compose up -d
scripts.db:stop: docker stop mongo-auth 2>/dev/null || docker compose down
scripts.test: pnpm --dir backend run test && pnpm --dir frontend run test
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend run lint && pnpm --dir frontend run lint
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend run build && pnpm --dir frontend run build
